headline: Spanish Utilities Reject CNMC Decision to Redirect Network Surplus to Other Energy Costs
summary: Spain's National Commission for Markets and Competition finalized the 2025 system liquidation, reallocating 428 million euros from electricity network surpluses to other bill costs, drawing pushback from utilities.
why: Regulatory decisions regarding network tariff surpluses and cost allocations directly impact capital expenditure plans and earnings for regulated utility companies.
